summary.text: Sarah Copeland Hanzas is the incumbent Democratic Secretary of State, seeking a third two-year term. Before her election in 2022 she served nearly two decades in the Vermont House. In office she has overseen replacement of the state's election-management IT systems and civic-education programs, and she and the Attorney General won dismissal of a Department of Justice suit demanding Vermont's unredacted voter list.

paragraphs.text: Served in the Vermont House of Representatives for nearly two decades before becoming Secretary of State; lives in Bradford.
First elected Secretary of State in 2022 and re-elected in 2024.
